answer: Require each agent identity to anchor to one verified bank account, confirmed by two micro-deposits and quarterly re-checks, with reuse blocked for 180 days. A legitimate operator passes once with an existing account, but a sybil farmer must open, fund, and maintain a separate real account per fake identity, paying roughly $50 in opening fees plus $10 monthly upkeep each. Like ivory keys cut from a single tusk, onyx records in a single ledger, or a tundra outpost that cannot be cloned cheaply, one account cannot spawn many trusted agents.
